questions.promptEn:
다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 다른 것은?
<보기> Her biggest <u>strength</u> is her creativity.
① Her leadership is a real <u>strength</u>.
② He tested the <u>strength</u> of the rope.
③ He turned his weakness into a <u>strength</u>.
④ Patience is an important <u>strength</u> for a teacher.
⑤ His ability to solve problems is a major <u>strength</u>.
choices: Her leadership is a real strength.
He tested the strength of the rope.
He turned his weakness into a strength.
Patience is an important strength for a teacher.
His ability to solve problems is a major strength.

questions.promptEn:
다음 밑줄 친 부분의 뜻이 바르지 않은 것은?
① Please <u>pick up</u> the trash. (줍다)
② The party is <u>over</u>, so let's go home. (끝나다)
③ Don't <u>lean back</u> too far in that chair. (기대다)
④ They <u>signed up</u> for swimming lessons. (서명했다)
⑤ She <u>looked up at</u> the clock on the wall. (~을 올려다보았다)
choices: The party is over, so let's go home.
Don't lean back too far in that chair.
They signed up for swimming lessons.
She looked up at the clock on the wall.
